snippet.title: Recap | Animula Nook Alpha Test | Love at First Arrival
snippet.description:
To Every Wishweaver Who Arrived: Thank You for the Magic and Love.

It feels like only yesterday that we first handed out the Minietopia Arrival Cards. Though the doors to our Alpha Test have officially closed, the journey we’ve started in Minietopia is here to stay. 

Through those shared moments, Minietopia became more than just a world to live in—it became a true home, built by the hands and hearts of all our Wishweavers. Every second you spent here has been a treasure.

It was a joy to see how you:
🏠 Built wild and free, creating a sanctuary that truly felt like you. 
🎶 Connected through music and dance, from soulful solo melodies to unexpected duets with strangers. 
🫶 Shared love and hope, letting every leap in the woods carry the spirit of Relay for Life. 
🍋 Found sweetness in every moment—even when the lemon juice was sour, the memories remained pure gold.

Through your eyes and through our stories, we’ve built something lasting together.

Thank you for being part of our first chapter. We can't wait to write the next one with you.

See you! 🌟

#AnimulaNookAlphaTest #AnimulaNook #ComeMakeItHome #ComeTakeItHome #MinietopiaArrivalCard
